claims.text: Push failures
claims.note: The failure outcome of the push progress dialog.

claims.text: Reading the failure count and retrying safely.
claims.note: The count is in SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_ERROR. For retrying safely, see push-failures/4/2: the failures come back unticked under Pushed Today.

claims.text: Read the failure count, understand what has already been tried, and re-push only what failed.
claims.note: The count is in the message. Two automatic retries have already run, and only the failed stations are still pending. Re-pushing only what failed is possible, but the failed stations have to be ticked first (see push-failures/4/2).

claims.text: Push progress dialog
claims.note: The failure is reported in the "Pushing Changes To Lynx" progress dialog.

claims.text: The Spatial Adjust dashboard, at /spatialadjust.
claims.note: The route is /spatialadjust. Reworded from dashboard-overview/where/1.

claims.text: The push progress window, after a push that ended with a failure.
claims.note: The failure is reported in the push progress dialog. Reworded from push-failures/where/1.

claims.text: Lynx must be set up as Push changes to Lynx describes, with Site Adjust and Course Adjust both at 100% in Lynx.
claims.note: Push changes to Lynx lists the settings under Before you start. Reworded from push-failures/before/2, push-to-lynx/before/4.

claims.text: By the time you see a failure, Spatial Adjust has already retried the affected stations twice.
claims.note: Retyped from prerequisite to behaviour. Re-confirmed on production: the failure count appears only after the retry counter reaches MAX_RETRY_COUNT (2), so the stations in it have had two automatic retries after the first attempt. This covers the failure count, which is what the guide is about. A different failure gets no retry at all: if the read-back from Lynx fails, the progress dialog closes with no count and only a Lynx error toast is shown (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:174-178, sa-dashboard.component.ts:305-314).

claims.text: Lynx itself must be set up to match Spatial Adjust.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.1 lists the Lynx settings Spatial Adjust depends on: Site Adjust and Course Adjust, Pct. Adjust, and Next Amt.

claims.text: Push changes to Lynx lists the settings under Before you start.
claims.note: Cross-reference within the guides: push-to-lynx/before/4 to /before/9 carry the settings, each from 373-1135 rev 02 §Settings Configuration, p.1.

claims.text: Read the count, not the color
claims.note: The result line pairs a red times-circle icon with the text that carries the count. Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.

claims.text: Read the number in the result line above [[Close]].
claims.note: The result line sits above the Close button, which shows once the run is complete (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:142, :155-164); Close is STRINGS.CLOSE (en-us.json:648). Reworded from push-failures/1/1, push-failures/1/2.

claims.text: The line names how many stations could not be updated, such as 2.
claims.note: The count is in SPATIAL_ADJUST.LYNX_PUSH_ERROR. Reworded from push-failures/1/2.

claims.text: If the window closed with no result, Spatial Adjust could not read Lynx back.
claims.note: If the read-back from Lynx fails, the progress dialog closes with no result (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:174-178). Reworded from push-failures/before/1, push-failures/3/3.

claims.text: Check the connection to Lynx.
claims.note: The product gives the same advice in its own failure message. Reworded from push-failures/3/1.

claims.text: A failure is partial: the stations that verified already match Lynx.
claims.note: Only stations whose read-back value still differs are retried and counted. Reworded from push-failures/1/3.

claims.text: Two stations could not be updated.
claims.note: Figure caption.

claims.text: The other four are done.
claims.note: Figure caption. Only the stations still mismatched after the last retry are reported as failed.

claims.text: Know what has already been tried
claims.note: The retries are automatic and bounded by MAX_RETRY_COUNT.

claims.text: Look at the line under the progress bar while the failed stations are retried.
claims.note: The progress dialog shows the retry line and the bar (en-us.json:417). Reworded from push-failures/2/1, push-failures/2/5.

claims.text: The line says the failed stations are being retried, and the bar restarts at zero and counts only those stations.
claims.note: Settled fact in docs/text-corrections.md section 7: the step counter resets to 0 and the total is recalculated for the failed stations alone. Reworded from push-failures/2/5, push-failures/2/2.

claims.text: If you push again by hand straight after a failure, that is a fourth attempt over the same connection.
claims.note: One attempt plus two automatic retries makes three, so a manual re-push is the fourth, over the same Lynx path. The cut half of the old sentence, how often it behaves differently, stays Needs expert and is not published. Reworded from push-failures/2/3.

claims.text: Check the connection first.
claims.note: The same advice as the product's failure message. Reworded from push-failures/3/1.

claims.text: Each failed station is tried up to 2 more times before the failure is shown.
claims.note: Two further passes, each re-sending only the stations that did not verify. Reworded from push-failures/2/2.

claims.text: The automatic retry pass, before the failure is reported.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Retrying step comes before Errors.

claims.text: The bar restarts at zero and counts only the stations being retried.
claims.note: Figure caption. Settled fact re-confirmed on production (docs/text-corrections.md section 7): the step counter resets to 0 and the total is recalculated for the failed stations alone.

claims.text: Check the connection to Lynx
claims.note: The product gives the same advice in its own failure message: "Check the connection to Lynx and try again."

claims.text: Hold Shift + Alt and click the Spatial Adjust logo.
claims.note: The handler opens the dialog only with Shift and Alt held (sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:293-299). Reworded from station-zero/5/2.

claims.text: The diagnostics dialog opens, and under Lynx, Can ping cloud shows true.
claims.note: Can ping cloud shows true when a live ping gets a reply; its labels are hardcoded English. Reworded from push-failures/3/2, push-failures/verify/2.

claims.text: If Can ping cloud shows false, or a banner above the toolbar says the connection to Lynx is lost, re-pushing will not help.
claims.note: A failing ping means the read-back cannot be made, so a push cannot verify; the amber banner means values can be neither read nor written. Reworded from push-failures/3/3, push-failures/3/5.

claims.text: Check the connection to Lynx first.
claims.note: The same advice as the product's failure message. Reworded from push-failures/3/1.

claims.text: The dialog opens a second or so after the page loads, and also when Lynx data has failed to load.
claims.note: Corrected rule: docs/text-corrections.md section 27. Reworded from station-zero/5/3.

claims.text: Diagnostics: Lynx interconnect, ping, installation ID.
claims.note: Figure caption. The Diagnostics dialog opens only on a Shift+Alt click on the Spatial Adjust logo, and only once a Lynx course is loaded or Lynx has failed to load (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:4, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:293-299). No guide step says how to open it. Its labels are hard-coded English (sa-diagnostics-dlg.component.html:22-89).

claims.text: Re-push only the failures
claims.note: Possible, but only by ticking the failed stations under Pushed Today, where they arrive unticked (see push-failures/4/2).

claims.text: Under [[Pushed Today]], tick each station that failed.
claims.note: Failed stations return under Pushed Today, unticked (docs/text-corrections.md section 18). Reworded from push-failures/4/2, push-failures/4/3.

claims.text: The count on the footer button rises by 1 for each row you tick.
claims.note: The footer button counts only ticked rows. Reworded from push-to-lynx/4/2, push-failures/4/3.

claims.text: If the dialog is closed, select [[Push Changes]] at the right of the toolbar.
claims.note: The Push Changes button is in the right-hand part of the toolbar (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:34-41). Reworded from push-to-lynx/where/1, push-failures/4/2.

claims.text: If rows under Available to Push are ticked that you did not mean to send, untick them.
claims.note: The stations that went through are not listed again. Reworded from push-failures/4/4.

claims.text: The failed stations count as pushed today, so they come back unticked.
claims.note: Failed stations count as pushed today, so they arrive unticked. Reworded from push-failures/4/2.

claims.text: The failed stations are still queued; the successful ones are not.
claims.note: Figure caption. Correct: a station that verified matches Lynx and drops out of the pending list, and a failed one does not. Where the failed ones appear is covered under push-failures/4/2.

claims.text: Push window. Push between 11 AM and the synchronization time set in Lynx, and synchronize Lynx after the push.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 p.10 gives the window, 11 AM to the synchronisation time set in Lynx, and says to synchronise after the push. It names no time zone and does not say how to synchronise. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing). Wording updated after the 2026-10-22 walkthrough review (American spelling, station and sprinkler terms); the fact is unchanged.
claims.question: Q1 and Q2 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md): is the 11 AM in the course's local time or US Eastern Time, and does the synchronisation Lynx runs at its scheduled time pick up an earlier push, or must the superintendent synchronise Lynx by hand after every push?

claims.text: Outside that window the push does not reach the course, and no error tells you so.
claims.note: 373-1135 rev 02 gives the window but never says what happens outside it, and IntelliDash has no push-window logic. Published before the answer by the guides owner's decision of 2026-10-19, for the in-person review on 2026-10-22 (docs/claims/operational-contract.md § Publishing).
claims.question: Q3 and Q4: does a push made after the Lynx synchronisation time, or before 11 AM, fail to reach the course, and does anything in Spatial Adjust or Lynx report it? (The push dialog would still verify the values against Lynx and report success.)

claims.text: You know how many stations failed and which they were.
claims.note: The count is in the result line, but no message names the stations (the failedStations list in sa-push-progress-info.model.ts:17 is used only for counts). The reader can tell which ones failed only from Push Changes, where they are the Pushed Today rows, or from the pushed-today icon in the table (sa-table-card.component.ts:545-556). A station the minimum threshold rewrote carries the same marks.

claims.text: Diagnostics confirms Lynx is reachable before you retry.
claims.note: "Can ping cloud:" shows true when a live ping gets a reply. It also shows false, without pinging, while a read from Lynx is in progress (cloud-service-base.ts:256). The Diagnostics dialog opens only on a Shift+Alt click on the Spatial Adjust logo, and only once a Lynx course is loaded or Lynx has failed to load (sa-main-toolbar.component.html:4, sa-main-toolbar.component.ts:293-299). No guide step says how to open it. Its labels are hard-coded English (sa-diagnostics-dlg.component.html:22-89).

claims.text: The retry contained only the failed stations.
claims.note: Achievable: the footer count and the list sent are exactly the ticked rows. Following the guide as it stands will not achieve it (see push-failures/4/3).
